title: 8-to-3 Priority Encoder
statement: Create an 8-to-3 priority encoder that encodes the highest-priority asserted input into a binary output. Input 7 has the highest priority and input 0 the lowest. If no inputs are asserted, output should be zero and valid must be low. The encoder must resolve priority with a single combinational pass.
module_signature: module priority_encoder_8to3(input [7:0] in, output reg [2:0] code, output valid);
behavior: code indicates the index of the highest asserted input.
valid is 1 when any input bit is high, else 0.
Behavior must be purely combinational despite reg output syntax.
Purely combinational: outputs must settle after input changes.
Do not depend on initial register values, clocks, or delays.
All outputs must be driven to known 0/1 values for every input case.
constraints: Do not use sequential procedural loops or clocked always blocks.
hint: Evaluate inputs from highest to lowest priority.
